crossRefs.note: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

people.name: Ahi
people.line: Son of Abdiel, a Gadite chief

people.name: Guni
people.line: A descendant of Gad; father of Abdiel.

translations.web: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
translations.bsb: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
translations.kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
